answer: Tie each agent to a refundable stake bonded to a scarce external anchor, like a verified compute attestation, before it may trade. Spawning a sybil fleet then costs real capital per identity, the way a jetty charges every boat that docks. An honest agent pays once and recoups it; an attacker launching a plume of juniper-thin clones burns that bond on each fake, so forgery cost scales linearly with the identities while voting weight stays capped.
